name: Autumn village
one_line: Cobbles, crooked cottages and leaves coming down.
look_words: A small village on an autumn afternoon. Faded olive grass, cream plaster and timber, slate roofs, cobbles half buried in rust-coloured leaves, maples in orange and gold. The sun is low and soft, the sky a grey-blue, and chimney smoke hangs in the air. Shapes are crooked and friendly, with hand-painted textures. Because orange is everywhere, the things that matter are a clear bright yellow and a clean cream-white; harm is a hot pink-crimson; the player wears a strong blue. Motion is leaves: falling, blowing across the lane, kicked up underfoot. Avoid summer greens, clean modern surfaces, heavy darkness and bloom.

palette.name: autumn lane
palette.notes: Paths are leaf rust, so harm is a hot pink-crimson rather than orange-red, and pickups are a cleaner yellow than any leaf.

look_wish: hand-painted shading, coloured pencil, or none

upgrade.why: draws the whole village as a sketchbook page in coloured pencil

sound_feel: leaves underfoot, a bicycle bell, distant voices, crows

frames.prompt: Autumn village in late afternoon, high three-quarter camera: a small postman in a teal jacket rides a bicycle down a cobbled lane between half-timbered cottages with slate roofs, maple trees in orange, rust and gold dropping leaves, pumpkins by a doorstep, a stone bridge, chimney smoke. Soft low golden light, long shadows, a grey-blue sky. Stylised hand-painted 3D, cosy and lived-in. Gameplay view of a stylised indie video game, no text, no user interface, no logos, no watermark.
